# ValuSource

> > ValuSource provides comprehensive valuation and appraisal software solutions for business professionals, appraisers, brokers, and legal specialists.

ValuSource is a leading provider of business valuation, appraisal, and economic damages software serving CPAs, appraisers, business brokers, and legal professionals. The platform offers integrated tools for business valuation, M&A comparables, and litigation support across multiple user segments.

## Key Topics

- Business Valuation Software
- Economic Damages Assessment
- ValuSource Pro
- SyncWarrior
- Damages Advocate
- BVDataWorld
- BESWeb
- Personal Injury Damages
- Business Appraisal
- Valuation Databases
- M&A Comparables
- Legal Software Tools
- Business Brokers
- CPAs and Appraisers
- Wrongful Death Damages

## Core Products

- [Products - ValuSource](https://www.valusource.com/products): ValuSource product suite overview including valuation and appraisal tools
- [Business Appraiser Software - ValuSource](https://www.valusource.com/products/business-appraiser-software): ValuSource Pro business valuation software for CPAs and appraisers
- [Damages Advocate - ValuSource](https://www.valusource.com/products/economic-damages-specialists/damages-advocate/overview): Damages Advocate for personal injury, wrongful death, employment damages
- [BESWeb - ValuSource](https://www.valusource.com/products/business-brokers/besweb/overview): BESWeb business valuation software for brokers with comparable data
- [Online Business Valuation - ValuSource](https://www.valusource.com/products/business-owners/online-business-valuation/overview): Online Business Valuation tool for small business ballpark assessments

## Databases & Data Solutions

- [BVDataWorld - ValuSource](https://www.valusource.com/products/business-appraiser-databases/bvdataworld/overview): BVDataWorld market comparables and M&A transaction database overview
- [SyncWarrior - ValuSource](https://www.valusource.com/products/business-appraiser-software/sync-warrior): SyncWarrior Excel/Word add-on for automated valuation report generation
